algorithm: Original bounded QK and maximum/BF16-probability repair; scalar original prepared-dot replay with complete exceptional fallback; cached unrounded probability intervals; eighteen strict BF16 context certificate passes with halving maximum-contribution threshold and complete remaining-score fallback. The independently computed candidate numerator uses only its own certified probabilities and alphas. Output uses the lower denominator endpoint only after all BF16 output endpoints certify. Reference values never choose work or feed outputs.
comparisons_scope: Every causal approximate score is checked against the original prepared score envelope; every replayed score is compared bit-for-bit, with independent wide CPU samples. All BF16 probabilities, alpha bits, denominator containment at every round, every admitted output, final output and buffer guards are checked. The q7169 capture compares all29364224 GB10 context cells. q8192 repeats the first1023 captured Q/K/V rows; all33554432 outputs match the original arithmetic, with only the original7169-token prefix independently GB10 anchored. It is not a new q8192 real-model inference or token gate.
